# The Farm Media

> The Farm Media is a marketing agency based in Springfield, Missouri that builds websites, local SEO, paid ads, and instant price range calculators exclusively for concrete coating companies (epoxy, polyaspartic, polyurea, and decorative concrete) across the Midwest.

The Farm Media does not serve general clients — every site, ad account, and automation is built specifically for concrete coating contractors. The flagship product is the "Instant Price Range Calculator," an interactive tool embedded on client websites that gives homeowners a real price range before they call, paired with a CRM pipeline ("The Concrete Jobs System™") that captures and follows up on leads automatically.

## Pages

- [Home](https://thefarmmedia.com/): Overview of The Farm Media's services, the Concrete Jobs System, a live demo of the instant price calculator, pricing, and results.
- [Instant Price Calculator](https://thefarmmedia.com/instant-price-calculator.html): Live interactive demo of the instant price range calculator tool built into client websites, including the real gated "calculate then unlock with contact info" lead-capture flow.
- [Pricing](https://thefarmmedia.com/pricing.html): Website build pricing (starting at $2,499 one-time) and two monthly growth packages — Foundation ($500/mo, single-crew) and Scale ($1,000/mo, two-crew).
- [Results](https://thefarmmedia.com/results.html): Real campaign statistics, a photo gallery of concrete coating jobs completed by clients, and links to live client websites.
- [About](https://thefarmmedia.com/about.html): Company background, based in Springfield, MO, serving Missouri, Kansas, Arkansas, Oklahoma, Iowa, Illinois, Nebraska, and the surrounding Midwest.
- [Contact](https://thefarmmedia.com/contact.html): Contact form, phone, and email to book a free strategy call.

## Service Pages

- [Website Design](https://thefarmmedia.com/website-design.html): Custom website design and development for concrete coating companies.
- [Local SEO](https://thefarmmedia.com/local-seo.html): Google Business Profile optimization and local search ranking.
- [Advertising](https://thefarmmedia.com/advertising.html): Facebook and Google ad campaign management.
- [CRM & Automation](https://thefarmmedia.com/crm-automation.html): CRM setup and automated text/email lead follow-up (GoHighLevel-based).
- [Reviews & Reputation](https://thefarmmedia.com/reviews-reputation.html): 1-click Google review tools and automated review requests.
- [Color Visualizer](https://thefarmmedia.com/color-visualizer.html): Homeowner picks a coating color and automatically receives real installed photos by email.
- [Online Booking](https://thefarmmedia.com/online-booking.html): Homeowners book their own on-site estimate directly from the website.
